title: Record delivery response
description: Response returned when a delivery is recorded.

data.description: The Deliveries minted by the request.

deliveries.description: One Delivery per distinct waste type represented in the submitted Movement IDs. Most requests produce a single-item list.

deliveryItem.title: Delivery item
deliveryItem.description: A single Delivery minted from a `POST /deliveries` request, covering the Movements sharing one waste type.

movementIds.description: The subset of the submitted Movement IDs covered by this Delivery.

movementId.title: Movement ID
movementId.description: Unique identifier for a waste movement, minted by the server on `POST /movements`.

deliveryId.title: Delivery ID
deliveryId.description: Unique identifier for a delivery, minted by the server on `POST /deliveries`.

wasteType.title: Waste type
wasteType.description: Whether the waste covered by this delivery is hazardous or non-hazardous.
